links.inference_note: The model-driven sectoring schedules of Garcia-Prats et al. (2012) and Jimenez-Bello et al. (2010a) are said to reduce energy but not to optimise water use because all intakes in a sector irrigate for the same time, which the paper states results in inefficient water management.

Once sectors were created, the pumping calendar was established by means of genetic algorithms (GA) with the aim of minimising a multi-objective function: energy consumption, system failures (the number of hydrants with insufﬁcient pressure), and irrigation deﬁcits simultaneously.
links.inference_note: The citation to Fernández García et al. (2013) sits in the preceding sentence; the GA-based pumping calendar (model-driven scheduling) is described as minimising system failures and irrigation deficits, i.e. improving supply reliability.
